svg.text: Finance Module Process Flowchart
Current implementation: PayMongo deposits • finance ledger • inventory • cash closing • expenses • reporting
ACCESS CONTROL: active session + finance_officer/admin role + privileged MFA for Finance API
1. Online reservation deposit and PayMongo
Client starts appointment checkout
Create local pending checkout + PayMongo hosted URL
Customer pays at PayMongo
Confirmation route or signed webhook receives outcome
Valid signature, PHP, mode,
paid state, local amount?
NO — reject / leave unconsumed
Valid unmatched webhook: warning + HTTP 200, no alert
Amount or line mismatch: checkout is not consumed
YES — lock checkout and re-check clinic slot
Create confirmed appointment + posted reservation payment
Mark checkout consumed; replayed webhook is idempotent
YES
NO
Appointment time passed or clinic slot became unavailable after payment?
Applies after external payment but before successful appointment creation
YES → attempt full PayMongo refund; external/local state can diverge if DB update fails
NO → appointment + reservation ledger become available to Finance
2. Balance payment, refund, and reversal
Finance posts a balance receipt
Completed, non-demo appointment + amount + method
Outstanding amount valid?
Booked price − all posted payments; reservation deposit offsets balance
NO
No ledger receipt
YES
Cash date open if cash
Insert posted payment
Correction paths
Cash cancelled reservation: mark refunded only if eligible + date open.
Reversal changes ledger only; it never returns customer money. Partial refunds are not implemented.
3. Product sale and inventory
Finance records sale with UUID request key
Product, quantity, price, method and reference
Existing request key or insufficient stock?
Advisory request lock + inventory row FOR UPDATE
Replay / reject
Same details: replayed=true
Different key data / no stock: 409
Commit as one transaction
Reduce stock + payment + detail
Inventory “Sale” movement
Later reversal
Reverse ledger + save audit reason + restore stock + write “Sale Reversed.”
Legacy sale without detail cannot safely reverse.
4. Cash closing, expenses, reports, and exports
Cash closing by Manila date
Expected = posted non-demo cash receipts
Already closed / invalid amount / future date?
One advisory lock and one close per date
Save close and variance
Notify Finance/Admin on discrepancy
Expense and purchase workflow
Create/edit: validates and locks business date; edits store JSON history.
Void: soft-void with reason. Purchase suggestion: one linked Inventory & Supplies expense.
After close
Cash receipts and expense actions for that date are blocked (409).
Expense settlement method is not stored; closing is not full cash-flow reconciliation.
Dashboard / report / CSV & XLSX: sales earned, cash collected, receivables, ledger, expenses, daily reconciliation
5. Important data outcomes and documented limitations
Confirmed safeguards
Signed webhook timestamp/HMAC checks • duplicate checkout handling • product-sale idempotency
stock locking • overpayment prevention • closed-date gates • audit trail on reversals/expense edits
Limitations / reconciliation risks
No partial refunds • manual “paymongo” balance method does not call PayMongo
unmatched valid webhook has no alert • external refund can succeed before local DB update fails
Reporting interpretation
“Sales earned” is not the same as “cash collected.” Retained no-show/forfeited deposits count as sales under active rules.
Net income is total collected minus expenses, explicitly an operational metric—not a complete cash-flow statement.
Source basis: current routes/finance.js, routes/appointments.js, middleware, utilities, migrations, and Finance UI scripts • reviewed 11 November 2026
